maddeler.e:
نتناوب (form VI)
# نَتَنَاوَبُ (natanāwabu) /na.ta.naː.wa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاوَبَ (tanāwaba)
# نَتَنَاوَبَ (natanāwaba) /na.ta.naː.wa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاوَبَ (tanāwaba)
# نَتَنَاوَبْ (natanāwab) /na.ta.naː.wab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاوَبَ (tanāwaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
